focus: 临时请假、延长假期、远程办公
sentences: I need to take urgent leave. My father had an accident.
我需要紧急请假。我父亲出事了。
Can I take tomorrow off and work from home for the rest of the week?
我明天能请假，然后这周剩下的时间居家办公吗？
I may need to extend my leave by two more days.
我可能需要把假期再延长两天。
I can still join the site meeting online from my hometown.
我在老家也能线上参加现场会议。
Could we move my leave dates? I'll come back earlier.
能不能改一下我的休假日期？我提前回来。
I'll keep my phone on and reply to messages after hours.
我会保持手机开机，下班后也会回消息。
Let me confirm the dates with you by tonight.
我今晚之前跟你确认日期。
